If an established responsibility is already asking more effort than usual, each addition has to find its hours somewhere. Following a few lines of curiosity may help a direction take shape. If several projects compete for the same afternoon, sampling a few and choosing one to pursue may be different stages.

Saturn's square to your natal Sun is a picture of expectations pressing against the capacity to meet them. This is the second of three calculated contacts; the first exact contact falls in September 2026. If an earlier way of fitting the task in no longer works, this return offers a chance to adjust one part of the method or boundary.

A note can hold the second idea without turning it into a second commitment. For the project you choose, the useful change might be a defined stopping point: what belongs inside this afternoon, and what stays outside it.
